expected_class: medium/large local GGUF with partial CPU offload
notes: Conservative default: the planner prefers a configuration that loads reliably. On 8 GB VRAM a ~20-21 GB Q4_K_M MoE model does not fit fully; llama.cpp offloads what it can and the remainder runs on system RAM. Expect lower decode throughput than VRAM-resident models. KV cache q8_0 requires head_dim divisible by 32 — all curated models satisfy this; a non-quantized fallback (f16) exists if a future model does not.
